clusters.name: seam-and-probe
clusters.executionModeRationale: Must land first; it introduces the CODEX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_FLAG constant, the capability probe, and the idleTimeoutSec client option that later edits to codexAppServerClient.ts build on. Serialize because it shares the central client file with the rss-sampling cluster.

clusters.name: rss-sampling
clusters.executionModeRationale: Edits refreshLastSampledRssKb() in the same client file as US-001 and touches the doctor probe shared with US-003; must serialize after seam-and-probe and before doctor-orphan-age to avoid conflicting edits on both shared files.

clusters.name: doctor-last-disconnect-age
clusters.executionModeRationale: Adds last-disconnect age column + bucket-summary rendering to the same doctor file the rss-sampling cluster modifies; serialize after rss-sampling.

clusters.name: docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Documents the shipped behavior; depends on all code clusters. The optional US-004 kill-idle story (only if the operator opts in) inserts as phase 3.5 depending on phases 1-3.
